mapper.select: select department_id, department_code, department_name, department_level, parent_id, manager_id, is_active from department where is_active = 1 order by department_id

select d.department_id, d.department_code, d.department_name, d.department_level, d.parent_id, d.manager_id, d.is_active, m.ename as manager_name, mj.job_name as manager_job_name, (select count(*) from emp e where e.department_id = d.department_id and e.status = 'ACTIVE') as member_count from department d left join emp m on m.emp_id = d.manager_id left join job mj on mj.job_id = m.job_id where d.is_active = 1 order by d.department_id

select e.emp_id, e.emp_no, e.ename, e.email, e.phone, e.hiredate, e.photo_path, e.status, d.department_id, d.department_name, d.department_level, d.manager_id, j.job_id, j.job_name, j.job_level from emp e join department d on d.department_id = e.department_id join job j on j.job_id = e.job_id where e.department_id = #{departmentId} and e.status = 'ACTIVE' order by case when e.emp_id = d.manager_id then 0 else 1 end, j.job_level desc, e.hiredate, e.emp_id
select count(*) from emp where department_id = #{departmentId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
select count(*) from department where parent_id = #{departmentId} and is_active = 1

select (select count(*) from emp where department_id = #{departmentId}) + (select count(*) from hr_appointment where before_department_id = #{departmentId} or after_department_id = #{departmentId}) + (select count(*) from department where parent_id = #{departmentId})
mapper.insert: insert into department(department_code, department_name, department_level, parent_id, manager_id, is_active) values(#{departmentCode}, #{departmentName}, #{departmentLevel}, #{parentId}, #{managerId}, 1)
mapper.update: update department set department_code = #{departmentCode}, department_name = #{departmentName}, department_level = #{departmentLevel}, parent_id = #{parentId}, manager_id = #{managerId}, is_active = #{isActive} where department_id = #{departmentId}
update department set is_active = 0, manager_id = null where department_id = #{departmentId}
